summary: Monkey Island entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: The Secret of Monkey Island
entries.definitive_edition: The Secret of Monkey Island: Special Edition on PC

emulation.notes: Use native Special Edition for primary; ScummVM only for original-release preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC Special Edition plus original SCUMM comparison where needed

primary.version: The Secret of Monkey Island: Special Edition
primary.why: The Special Edition is the current official route with remade art/audio, voice acting, hint support, and a switch back to the original presentation. That makes it the best one-route blend of access, fidelity, and historical comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PC Special Edition through Steam/GOG where available. Record storefront/build, classic-versus-special visuals, hint use, voice/audio settings, and whether original SCUMM/CD versions were compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original SCUMM-era presentation and interface variants
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if preserving exact original look/interface differences.
secondary.why: The Special Edition can toggle original audiovisuals but is still a later wrapper/remake.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record classic/special toggle use; do not treat the remake as identical to every original platform variant.

entries.title: The Curse of Monkey Island
entries.definitive_edition: Current Steam/GOG PC release, with Mega-Monkey difficulty state documented

emulation.emulator: ScummVM if using original data files
emulation.notes: Current GOG/Steam route is preferred; document ScummVM version if used directly.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Windows CD-ROM or ScummVM with original data files

primary.version: Current Steam/GOG release using ScummVM-style compatibility
primary.why: The current PC digital releases are the cleanest official route for the third Monkey Island game, with easy capture and compatibility support. Original CD-ROM media remains the historical artifact, and Mega-Monkey difficulty should be logged because it changes the puzzle route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam or GOG PC release. Record storefront/build, ScummVM or wrapper version if visible, display/filter settings, voice/subtitle settings, difficulty mode, and whether original CD media was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original packaging/installer and late-1990s Windows context
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting the original media route.
secondary.why: The current PC releases are more practical while preserving the game content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record difficulty mode, wrapper/ScummVM state, and display/filter settings.

entries.title: Monkey Island 2: LeChuck's Revenge
entries.definitive_edition: Monkey Island 2 Special Edition on PC, with original DOS/FM Towns route documented if needed

emulation.notes: Use Special Edition for primary; use ScummVM/original media for original-version comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Special Edition PC for modern presentation; original hardware/assets for original route

primary.version: Monkey Island 2 Special Edition: LeChuck's Revenge
primary.why: The Special Edition is the modern PC route with remastered art/audio, voice, commentary, and classic-mode switching. The DOS/FM Towns/Amiga/Mac originals remain important for original audio, UI, and difficulty/puzzle-history comparisons.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam or GOG Special Edition. Record classic/remastered art and audio settings, commentary state, difficulty mode, hint use, save state, and whether original DOS/FM Towns versions were compared.

secondary.platform: DOS / Amiga / Macintosh / FM Towns original versions
secondary.exclusive_content: Original presentation, interface, and audio variants
secondary.why: Special Edition is the best modern route but changes presentation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record classic/remastered toggles and difficulty selection; note that presentation differs from the original.

entries.title: Tales of Monkey Island

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Complete PC season with episode/build state documented

primary.version: Current Steam/GOG PC release where owned/available
primary.why: Tales is the episodic Telltale Monkey Island entry and PC is the cleanest capture route for all five chapters. WiiWare and older iOS routes are defunct or impractical, while current PC storefront/owned-library availability should be verified before capture.
primary.how_to_play: Use the complete PC season. Record storefront/source, episode, build, save/cross-episode state, graphics/input settings, subtitles, controller/mouse mode, and whether Wii/PS3/iOS routes were excluded.

secondary.why: PC is the practical complete archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record episode/save state and storefront ownership; do not merge with LucasArts-developed Monkey Island entries.
